mapper.update: INSERT INTO source_signal (source_id, origin, signal_key, detail) VALUES (#{sourceId}, #{origin}, #{signalKey}, #{detailJson, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.JsonbStringTypeHandler}) ON CONFLICT (source_id, origin, signal_key) DO UPDATE SET last_seen = now(), detail = EXCLUDED.detail
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM source_signal WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY origin, signal_key
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM source_signal WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND origin = #{origin} AND signal_key = #{signalKey}
